append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1629). PREMISE HELD on main at 3be160428: PushRegistration asked from its useEffect on every (main) mount. WHAT CHANGED. (1) components/push/registration.tsx never asks: it registers /sw.js, re-saves an existing subscription, and subscribes only a browser whose permission is already granted (no prompt). (2) components/push/subscribe.ts holds the only permission request in app/, components/ or lib/: enablePushFromTap, called from a click, whose first await is the request itself so it stays inside the gesture, which refuses before asking when permission already reads denied, waits for serviceWorker.ready, then subscribes and saves (a failed save tears the browser subscription down, as before). (3) components/push/availability.ts decides one state per browser: ios-install (iPhone or iPad in a Safari tab, decided before feature detection because a tab there has no PushManager), unsupported, denied, granted, askable. (4) components/push/permission-card.tsx: PushSettingsCard on Settings > Notifications (a line for every state, the "Turn on notifications" button only when askable or after a failed save), and PushNudge, a one-time card under a Going RSVP and on a Circle the member belongs to, shown at most once per device and only when a tap or the Home Screen step can help. iPhone Safari tabs get "Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open Frequency from there" instead of a button; a denied browser gets the browser-settings line and no button. The Settings grid footer now points at the card. TESTS: availability.test.ts, permission-card.test.tsx and registration.test.tsx cover each path (mount never asks, tap asks synchronously, denial terminal and never re-asked, dismissed keeps the button, failed save, iPhone tab, iPhone Home Screen app, no APIs, already granted, nudge once / Not now / stays away). Mutation-checked: asking on load, dropping the iOS rule, dropping the denied guard, an await before the ask, and a nudge that is not one-time each fail a test. No migration. Install guidance beyond the one line is LIVE-703 (awaits its ruling); native stays DEF-MOBILE (parked).
